stack.method: armclang -fstack-usage probe on the real product sources, with the target's IncludePath (project.uvprojx:343) and Define (project.uvprojx:5821) lists
stack.caveat: These are the compiled static local frames summed along the call path, i.e. a lower bound on that chain's usage. They are NOT the target stack high-water mark, they exclude callee-saved register pushes accounted by the ABI elsewhere, and at -O1 inlining may fold small callees into the caller's frame.
